```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (A B C : Set α) : A ∩ (B ∪ C) = (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ C) := by
  ext x
  split
  · intro h
    cases h with hA hBC
    constructor
    exact hA
    split
    · exact hBC.left
    · exact hBC.right
  · intro h
    cases h with hAB hAC
    constructor
    exact hAB
    split
    · exact hAC.left
    · exact hAC.right
```
